question: In which conference were The World Bank and its sister institution the International Monetary Fund created by the United Nations?

options.text: U. N. Conference on Trade and Employment
International Conference on Financing for Development

solution:
The correct answer is__** Bretton Woods Conference.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bretton Woods Conference** took place in **July 1944**, in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, USA.
 
• It was attended by representatives from **44 nations**, who aimed to establish a framework for international economic cooperation post-World War II.
 
• The conference resulted in the creation of the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** and the **World Bank** to promote global economic stability and development.
 
• The institutions were designed to facilitate international trade, reduce poverty, and foster sustainable economic growth among member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives of the IMF**: The IMF was created to ensure the stability of the international monetary system by providing financial assistance to countries facing balance of payments problems.
 
• **World Bank's Role**: The World Bank's primary focus is on providing long-term loans and grants to developing countries for development projects, aimed at reducing poverty and promoting economic progress.
 
• **Impact of Bretton Woods**: The Bretton Woods system established fixed exchange rates tied to the US dollar, which lasted until the early 1970s, significantly influencing global trade and economics.
 
• **Legacy**: The conference laid the groundwork for modern economic institutions and has shaped international economic policy for decades.
